relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: the receptor was named the Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) that recognizes lipopolysaccharide (LPS) of the Gram-negative bacteria as a pathogen-associated molecular pattern (PAMP)

key_findings: Overview chapter on TLRs in immunity, disease, SNPs, miRNA interactions, drug and vaccine design, and neuroscience including pain.
